notes: YOK-253 opt-in spam bot (Sparring Partner special-spam report 2026-11-14, F3 rec. 3a; P5, T2). Not a default anywhere: it plays only through --bot data/harness/newcomer-kihon-bot-spam-charge.json. It is the newcomer bot (newcomer-kihon-bot.json) with exactly two values added: fight.special_slot_only C (while slot C is filled, Iron-Club Charge is its only attack: the normal and throw weights count 0, mistakes and anti-airs press slot C, a punish uses slot C) and run.prefer_special iron-club-charge (its NEW card is taken whenever offered; with special_slot_only, upgrades and modifiers go on slot C first, no other special fills slot C and no NEW card replaces the charge, so the charge is Ryo's highest-level special and the Tanuki copies it, T2). Until Iron-Club Charge is drafted, slot C is empty and the bot plays exactly as the newcomer. Every other value is the newcomer's (R5: the calibrated levels are untouched). Smoke use only; no balance verdict (YOK-256).
